_doc: Manual inputs to classify.py. 'environment': tests the oracle control cannot pass in this environment, with the cause (checked against the control's own failure). 'public_api': original names that belong to the public surface (the SVG lint and style lint behind the CLI's lint and style commands, SPEC 3.6); a test using one the rewrite lacks is an applicable failure, not an inapplicable internal. 'public_api_attributes': failure texts that show a public class of the rewrite lacks an original method.

environment.tests.test_chartspec_jl.Writer.test_gene: needs Julia (tools/chartspec.jl, examples/gen/*.jl); julia is not installed, so the original skips it (skipped in both runs)
environment.tests.test_chartspec_jl.Writer.test_refu: needs Julia (tools/chartspec.jl); julia is not installed, so the original skips it (skipped in both runs)
environment.tests.test_chartspec_jl.Writer.test_valu: needs Julia (tools/chartspec.jl); julia is not installed, so the original skips it (skipped in both runs)
environment.tests.test_cli.Choose.test_refusal_names: expects the guide rule G8.2 printed beside R0-10; guide citations come from charts/GUIDE.md, absent from the share (oracle control fails the same assertion)
environment.tests.test_cli.Lint.test_findings_groupe: expects a 'guided' findings group; guide levels come from charts/GUIDE.md, absent (oracle control: ValueError substring not found)
environment.tests.test_notes.Drawn.test_eval_b12_spe: reads charts/eval/runs/opus/G/B12-instrument-charges/source/table.json; charts/eval/ is absent from the share (oracle control: FileNotFoundError)
environment.tests.test_rules.Levels.test_every_rule_: checks every rule's level against charts/GUIDE.md, absent (oracle control: 224 failing subtests); also uses the private rule tables
environment.tests.test_rules.Levels.test_guide_is_re: asserts more than 300 guide levels read from charts/GUIDE.md, absent (oracle control: 0 not greater than 300); also private
environment.tests.test_rules.Levels.test_the_retaggi: asserts guide-derived levels (R2-04 guided) that need charts/GUIDE.md, absent (oracle control: locked != guided); also private
environment.tests.test_svglint.Faults.test_too_many_: asserts the guided level of G4.20 read from charts/GUIDE.md, absent (oracle control: locked != guided)
environment.tests.test_svglint.Fixtures.test_every_f: asserts each finding's guide citation from charts/GUIDE.md, absent (oracle control: 29 failing subtests)

public_api.chartgen.svglint.lint_svg: the original SVG lint, SPEC 3.6, behind `python -m chartgen lint`; the rewrite has only the partial Rust lint_svg protocol operation (CG-SVG-PARTIAL), not this function
public_api.chartgen.style.lint_style: the original style lint behind `python -m chartgen style`; the rewrite's CLI reports it unimplemented

public_api_attributes.'Measurer' object has no attribute 'meas: chartgen.measure.Measurer.measure, the original batched measurement API; the rewrite's Measurer offers measure_requests only
public_api_attributes.'Measurer' object has no attribute 'one': chartgen.measure.Measurer.one, the original single-label measurement API; absent from the rewrite's Measurer
